title: First-factor shift-one coherence for total tensor reassociation
statement: Let C be an abelian braided monoidal category with additive tensor, monoidal closed structure, and countable colimits. Give CochainComplex C Z its total tensor and its canonical first-factor shift isomorphism s(P,T):P[1] tensor T -> (P tensor T)[1] (Mathlib mapBifunctorShift₁Iso). For arbitrary complexes P,T,U, alpha(P[1],T,U);s(P,T tensor U) equals (s(P,T) tensor id_U);s(P tensor T,U);alpha(P,T,U)[1]. No K-flatness or localization is assumed.

proof.text: Apply complex morphism extensionality in degree n, then mapBifunctor₁₂.hom_ext to the (p,q,r) summands. Expand the associator by ι_mapBifunctorAssociatorX_hom. Expand both triple summand inclusions via ι_eq and the two shift comparisons via ι_mapBifunctorShift₁Iso_hom_f. Use ι_mapBifunctorMap for whiskering the first shift. The shift component is the identity on the summand after replacing p by p+1. Both sides reduce to the associator summand formula at (p+1,q,r). Arithmetic gives the two admissible degree sums; category identities and reassociation complete the proof.

proof_origin.place: Explicit subargument of the parent representative calculation; Lean uses Mathlib total tensor and the recorded K-flat localization.

lean.statement:
theorem tensorShiftOne_associator (P T U : CochainComplex C ℤ) :
    (α_ (P⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) T U).hom ≫
        (mapBifunctorShift₁Iso P (T ⊗ U) (curriedTensor C) 1).hom =
      (mapBifunctorShift₁Iso P T (curriedTensor C) 1).hom ▷ U ≫
        (mapBifunctorShift₁Iso (P ⊗ T) U (curriedTensor C) 1).hom ≫
        (α_ P T U).hom⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧'
